# onboarding_golden fixture

> The frozen test data for the onboarding-quality fix campaign
> (Phase 0 / Lane II). Captures the **full output** of one live
> fresh-onboarding run against `test.alfred.black` on
> `2026-05-23` for the principal `david@szabostuban.com`.
>
> This fixture is the spec — every assertion in
> `tests/test_onboarding_quality_golden.py` is a quality rule
> grounded against these files.

## Source

- **Tenant:** `test.alfred.black` (Lane V test VM)
- **Principal:** `david@szabostuban.com`
- **Captured:** `2026-05-23`
- **Onboarding mode:** `composio` (GMAIL_FETCH_EMAILS), 5000-email
  backfill window
- **Pipeline version:** `harden/base` @ `280072d`
- **Capture method:** orchestrator pulled the rendered vault and the
  finished `onboard.json` directly from the tenant compose stack
  (`vault_data` + `learn_data` volumes), pre-staged into this
  directory. No code path generates this fixture — do not regenerate
  it. To capture a new generation, do another live onboarding run
  and copy the result into a new dated fixture (do NOT overwrite this
  one — phases consume it as a frozen baseline).

## Layout

```
onboarding_golden/
├── MANIFEST.md          # this file
├── onboard/
│   └── onboard.json     # the full pipeline working state — facts,
│                        # patterns, profile, brief, opportunities,
│                        # 5000 emails. ~3 MB. The vault is derived
│                        # from this.
└── vault/
    ├── USER.md
    ├── briefing/        # 1 record  (First Brief)
    ├── chore/           # 2 records (money-day, subscription-watchdog)
    ├── instinct/        # 13 records
    ├── matter/          # 17 records (9 gold + 8 junk)
    ├── note/            # 13 records (all junk)
    ├── org/             # 1 record  (junk: github.com)
    └── person/          # 23 records (21 plausible + 2 problematic)
```

| `needs_attention/*.md` | 0 | **Desk is empty on day one** — gap to close |

## Gold vs Junk — at a glance

**Gold (9)** — body has `## Context` section ≥ 400 chars,
`key_people`, `related_patterns`, `## Open questions`:

- `kondorosi-t-property-purchase`
- `neoterra-consulting-engagement`
- `founder-transition-kft-setup-and-compliance`
- `legacy-debts-uk-and-hungarian`

- `trkblint-home-projects`
- `alfred-black-platform`

- `lumberjack-and-screenless-dad-content`

**Junk (8)** — `<domain>-project.md`, ~250-bytes,
"Auto-generated from onboarding email analysis.", `domain:` in
frontmatter, `tier: inner_circle` autogenerated:

- `444-project`
- `digitalocean-project`
- `github-project`
- `google-project`
- `stripe-project`
- `substack-project`

### Notes

All 13 are junk service-summary records — bookkeeping that violates
the promotion contract. 4 of them are near-duplicates on GitHub:

- `GitHub Activity Summary.md`
- `GitHub Notification Summary.md`
- `GitHub Notifications and Service Emails Summary.md`
- `GitHub Service & Notification Summary.md`

Plausible (21): Andrew Newton, Caddie Rees, David Szabo-Stuban,
Eszter Szabó, Gergely Olti, Gergő Vokány, Henry Parry Okeden,
Jarabin Edina, Laczkó Gábor, Lóczi Balázs, Mark Hartnady, Miguel

## Per-generator attribution

See `packages/learn/docs/GENERATORS.md` for the full read-only
inventory and KEEP / GATE / KILL / LOG verdicts. Summary:

| Junk in fixture | Generator (KILL / GATE) |
|-----------------|-------------------------|
| 8 `*-project` matters | `generate_matter_pack` fallback (`packs.py:338`) — KILL |
| 13 notes | external alfred-vault curator over `batch_processor.drop_to_inbox` — KILL / route-to-log |
| `org/github.com` | `materialize_matter_entities` Pass B (`packs_opus.py:961`) — GATE: filter domain-named orgs |
| `person/Github Notifications` | same, Pass B — GATE: filter non-human names |
| `person/David Szabo-St` | same, Pass A — GATE: upstream key_people tokenization + prefix-dedup |
| 13 instincts conf 0.86+, obs 0 | `generate_instinct_pack_opus` (`packs_opus.py:1976`) — GATE: drop or rename `confidence_score` |
| missing `RULES.md` / `SOUL.md` | `personalize_opus` (`onboarding_v3.py:721`) — GATE: verify writes |
| missing Desk seeds | n/a — GAP: add a `done`-stage Desk seeder |

## Privacy

Contains **real PII** for the principal david@szabostuban.com — full
name, wife's name + email, real Hungarian/UK addresses, real
counterparty names (Gergely Olti, Henry Parry Okeden, …), real
property reference (`Kondorosi út 8/B`), real Kft details. The repo
is private; this fixture must **never** be copied to a public branch,
public mirror, or shared outside the alfred-platform private repo.

## How tests use this

`tests/test_onboarding_quality_golden.py` reads the fixture via
relative paths from the test file:

```python
FIXTURE = Path(__file__).parent / "fixtures" / "onboarding_golden"
```

Each test walks one record type (matter / note / instinct / person /
org) and asserts a quality rule. Many tests fail today — that is
deliberate. The failures ARE the spec.
